claims.value: BMDC_<strain>_<time>m_Rep<k>[_LS]_{infected|mock} — one infected and one mock source per MaxQuant experiment (= one SILAC digest)
claims.evidence: 6 MaxQuant experiments in experimentalDesignTemplate.txt / summary.txt (WT and DsbA x 60 min x 3 replicates). Paper: 'SILAC experiments were performed in biological triplicate for each time point and bacterial strain used and the respective mock-treated BMDCs served as a control ... In total, 18 digests (three time points/two bacterial strains/triplicate) were fractionated by HILIC. Aliquots of 6 digests (60 min p.i./two bacterial strains/triplicate) were also subjected to proteome analysis.' Each digest = one light + one heavy lysate mixed 1:1, so each digest contributes two physical samples. The replicate tags in the names are the authors' MaxQuant experiment names (10 min replicates are named Rep2, Rep3_LS, Rep4 by the authors). Row ranges: BMDC_WT_60m_Rep1_infected: rows 1-8; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep1_mock: rows 9-16; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep2_LS_infected: rows 17-24; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep2_LS_mock: rows 25-32; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep3_infected: rows 33-40; BMDC_WT_60m_Rep3_mock: rows 41-48; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep1_infected: rows 49-56; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep1_mock: rows 57-64; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep2_LS_infected: rows 65-72; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep2_LS_mock: rows 73-80; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep3_infected: rows 81-88; BMDC_DsbA_60m_Rep3_mock: rows 89-96. The PXD006759 source names are identical to the 60 min sources of PXD005747 because the paper states the proteome samples are aliquots of the same 6 digests.

claims.value: non-LS experiments: infected = SILAC light, mock = SILAC heavy; *_LS experiments: infected = SILAC heavy, mock = SILAC light
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "'light' cells were infected ... 'Heavy' cells were left as control/untreated groups. The whole experiment was done in biological triplicate with one label swap experiment (raw files containing 'LS' in name)." Paper: 'In two replicates, light BMDCs were infected and heavy cells were mock-treated. In one replicate, SILAC groups were swapped.' MaxQuant summary.txt: every non-LS experiment Labels0 '' / Labels1 'Arg6;Lys6', every LS experiment Labels0 'Arg6;Lys6' / Labels1 '' (paper: labels set 'in light channel for label-swap experiments to obtain inverted H/L ratios'), so MaxQuant 'H/L' = mock/infected in all experiments. Same protocol text in the PXD006759 PRIDE record. Within-deposit host-protein ratio correlations: non-LS vs non-LS +0.63/+0.64, LS vs non-LS -0.64 to -0.70 (label-specific bias, as in the phospho arm). Cross-deposit protein-group ratio correlation with the phospho search is highest for the same digest (WT Rep1 +0.17, WT Rep2_LS +0.13) and has the same sign pattern, consistent with shared digests and shared orientation. Proteome ratios at 60 min are small, so no marker-protein check is claimed; the map rests on the explicit statements plus the MaxQuant label assignment.

claims.value: infected sources 1-3 within each (strain, time) group; mock sources 1-6 within each time group (WT-paired 1-3, DsbA-paired 4-6)
claims.evidence: Paper: biological triplicate per time point and strain, each with its respective mock-treated control; each of the 18 digests contains its own mock lysate. Numbering restarts per factor-value group (spec README.adoc:330). Whether the WT- and DsbA-paired mocks of the same replicate came from one split mock culture is not stated (supplemental Fig. S1 not retrieved), so each mock lysate is counted as its own culture.
Mock-infected BMDCs are the controls ('Mock-infected BMDCs were centrifuged without bacteria'). PRIDE:0001013 study sample / PRIDE:0001014 control sample, children of PRIDE:0000895.
